notablePrerequisites: Jegantha does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Worldheart Phoenix, adding one mana of any color.
Cast Worldheart Phoenix from your graveyard by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Worldheart Phoenix enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
